Please try again later. ## Walkthrough The release updates the Azure File CSI driver to v1.35.5, adds VolumeAttributesClass-based file-share modification and OAuth-token mounting, refreshes Kubernetes and Azure dependencies, regenerates Helm artifacts and manifests, and expands unit and end-to-end coverage. ### Changes **Azure File CSI driver** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**ModifyVolume and authentication behavior**
`pkg/azurefile/...`|Adds `ControllerModifyVolume`, file-share modification clients, OAuth-token credential caching, folder and volume-ID validation, expanded request parsing, and updated CSI metrics.| |**Validation and driver tests**
`pkg/azurefile/*_test.go`|Adds coverage for ModifyVolume, OAuth-token mounting, folder validation, deterministic tag serialization, endpoint selection, and mount repair behavior.| **Deployment and Helm release** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**v1.35.5 Kubernetes manifests**
`deploy/...`|Updates CSI images, API throttling, node-driver-registrar health probes, VolumeAttributesClass support, CRDs, RBAC, and CSI driver settings.| |**Helm chart packaging**
`charts/...`|Regenerates chart versions, values, templates, CRDs, RBAC, packaged archives, and the repository index.| |**Release documentation and examples**
`README.md`, `docs/...`, `deploy/example/modifyvolume/...`|Documents v1.35.5 installation, VolumeAttributesClass parameters, and a PremiumV2 ModifyVolume example.| **End-to-end and build support** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**E2E feature coverage**
`test/e2e/...`|Adds VolumeAttributesClass modification tests and CAPZ-gated managed identity, OAuth-token, and workload identity mount tests.| |**Build and dependency updates**
`go.mod`, `pkg/azurefileplugin/Dockerfile`, `pkg/azurefile-proxy/install-proxy.sh`, `test/sanity/run-test.sh`|Refreshes Kubernetes/Azure dependencies, build images, AzCopy, aznfs, and pinned package versions.| |**Verification tooling**
`.golangci.yml`, `hack/verify-helm-chart-index.sh`|Migrates lint configuration to golangci-lint v2 and changes missing local chart URL handling to continue verification.| **Estimated code review effort:** 5 (Critical) | ~120 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant CSIClient participant ControllerModifyVolume participant AzureFileDriver participant FileShareAPI CSIClient->>ControllerModifyVolume: ModifyVolume(provisionedIOPS, provisionedBandwidth) ControllerModifyVolume->>AzureFileDriver: ModifyFileShare(...) AzureFileDriver->>FileShareAPI: Update share properties FileShareAPI-->>AzureFileDriver: Updated file share AzureFileDriver-->>ControllerModifyVolume: Return result ControllerModifyVolume-->>CSIClient: ModifyVolumeResponse ```

>## Upstream changelogs
>- https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/azurefile-csi-driver/releases/tag/v1.35.1

>
>## Summary of changes
>- **Sovereign cloud support for workload identity**: Added OAuth token-based mount support and credential cache for Azure sovereign clouds (e.g., Azure China, Azure Government).
>- **folderName validation**: Reject invalid characters (null bytes, path traversal) in folderName volume parameters.
>- **Stale mount race fix**: Fix ensureMountPoint to prevent stale mount cleanup races during node publish.
>- **privateDNSZoneResourceGroup parameter**: Added support for specifying the resource group of the private DNS zone.
>- **allowCrossTenantReplication parameter**: New storage class parameter to control cross-tenant replication.
>- **Removed deprecated HonorPVReclaimPolicy feature gate**: The feature gate has been removed as it is now GA in upstream Kubernetes.
>- **Liveness probe for node-driver-registrar**: Added health monitoring for the registrar sidecar.
>- **Numerous CVE fixes**: CVE-2026-24051, CVE-2026-24834, CVE-2026-33186, CVE-2026-39883, CVE-2026-35469, CVE-2026-41326, CVE-2026-25680, CVE-2026-27145, CVE-2026-42504, CVE-2026-42507.
>- **Dependency bumps**: Go 1.25.11, grpc v1.79.3, spdystream v0.5.1, x/crypto v0.53.0, azcopy v10.32.3, Azure cloud provider lib update, Kubernetes dependencies to v0.35.0.
>
